statement: A constitutional system must always reduce operator cognitive load while preserving constitutional guarantees. Constitutional safeguards constrain unsafe acts; they must never create unnecessary work for safe acts.
classification: OPERATOR EXPERIENCE (UX) invariant — a distinct class from the engineering resolution invariants. Engineering invariants govern how the system is BUILT; UX invariants govern how it BEHAVES FOR ITS HUMAN STEWARD. Operator-formalised 2026-08-03: "they have a different purpose". OPERATOR-NOMINATED FOR ELEVATION — the general standard the other nine specialise.

occurrences.defect: Constitutional isolation was implemented correctly and still increased operator workload: the surface diagnosed the exception and then required a separate search to act on it.

notes: Operator nominated this one for immediate elevation: "I think that's fundamental enough to sit alongside the engineering invariants."
